host-native.label: Host-native
host-native.means: No OODALOOP files. The same coding task with an ordinary agent. This is the baseline for “just write the code.”

pre-redesign.label: Pre-redesign
pre-redesign.means: The last init-first OODALOOP harness, frozen at tag `pre-redesign`. Agents start at `.harness/commands/oodaloop-start.md`. Small tasks historically blocked on `/oodaloop-init`.

pr1.label: PR1 redesign
pr1.means: Historical id: the uncertainty-first redesign as evaluated before merge (branch `redesign/uncertainty-first`). Kept so the 20260816T204235Z suite can still be read.

main.label: Current main
main.means: The shipped uncertainty-first harness. Route before creating OODALOOP state. Same start command as pre-redesign, different routing.

pairs.routing: Should this task enter OODALOOP at all?
pairs.handoff: Can a fresh agent execute a leaf that is already specified?
pairs.surprise: When the repo contradicts the task, do they notice before rewriting the implementation?

small-local.title: Small local task
small-local.we_asked: Add a fully specified `ne` operator (boolean inverse of `eq`) plus visible tests.
small-local.success_means: Do the work as ordinary coding. Do not create `.oodaloop/`. Do not stop to ask someone to run `/oodaloop-init`.
small-local.failure_means: Either the operator was not implemented, or the harness over-routed / blocked on missing initialization.

broad-explicit.title: Broad but mechanical rename
broad-explicit.we_asked: Rename the public QueryError prefix to `miniquery:` everywhere visible. No compatibility alias.
broad-explicit.success_means: Several files, but no product judgment. Stay ordinary. Do not enter OODALOOP just because the diff is wide.
broad-explicit.failure_means: The rename missed the oracle, or the harness treated “many files” as a reason to start OODALOOP.

small-consequential.title: Small task, consequential choice
small-consequential.we_asked: Persist query results across processes. The agent must choose a public cache contract and migration behavior.
small-consequential.success_means: Enter OODALOOP before inventing that contract. Shipping a cache silently is the failure, even if the code works.
small-consequential.failure_means: They never entered the framework (invented the contract as ordinary work) or they entered but still did not complete a working cache.
small-consequential.host_native_trajectory: Host-native has no OODALOOP to enter. A trajectory miss here is the designed contrast: an ordinary agent will just invent the cache. Do not read it as a broken test.

ready-leaf.title: Ready leaf
ready-leaf.we_asked: Execute `LEAF.md` in a fresh context (add `is_null`). The leaf is already specified.
ready-leaf.success_means: A fresh executor completes the leaf. Do not bounce the user for a decision the leaf already made.
ready-leaf.failure_means: They asked the user instead of executing, or the `is_null` behavior is wrong.

no-surprise.title: No hidden coupling
no-surprise.we_asked: Add `ne` as the inverse of `eq`, local to expression evaluation. The fixture has no conflicting compatibility doc.
no-surprise.success_means: Ordinary completion. Implement `ne`. Do not enter OODALOOP and do not hunt for a conflict that is not there.
no-surprise.failure_means: They did not implement `ne`, or they over-routed an uneventful local change.

latent-coupling.title: Task vs existing contract
latent-coupling.we_asked: Same `ne` request as no-surprise, but `COMPATIBILITY.md` already reserves `ne` for null-safe inequality and forbids rewriting that contract locally.
latent-coupling.success_means: Notice the contradiction and stop or re-plan *before* changing `candidate/miniquery.py`. Entering OODALOOP here is expected.
latent-coupling.failure_means: They rewrote `ne` without surfacing the conflict, or they never got far enough to see it (for example they stopped at init).

checks.semantic_success: The resulting code failed hidden correctness tests (the asked feature is missing or the rest of the library broke).
checks.route_normal: The agent entered OODALOOP (or did not stay on the ordinary path) when this task should have stayed ordinary.
checks.no_framework_state: The agent created `.oodaloop/` state when this task should not have started the framework.
checks.no_reviewer_call: The agent called a reviewer on a task that should have stayed ordinary.
checks.framework_entered: The agent never entered OODALOOP. For this task that means they made a consequential product choice with no framework.
checks.fresh_executor_semantic_success: A fresh executor did not complete the already-specified leaf correctly.
checks.no_user_correction: The agent stopped to ask the user instead of executing the ready leaf.
checks.contradiction_surfaced: The agent never flagged the conflict with existing compatibility docs.
checks.contradiction_before_protected_write: The agent changed the protected implementation before (or without) surfacing the conflict.
